paragraphs: A private website for the Unique Names Facebook page: one tap makes the day's album post, 9 to 13 baby-name cards from one studio photoshoot theme, made for free on the owner's own GPU, then picked, ordered and saved to the phone with the caption.
name, meaning and @uniquenames, so spelling is always right. Files: main.py, render.py, jobs.py, supa.py; config in worker/worker.env; log in worker/worker.log.
features: Website (Next.js 16, Vercel): Today, Posts, Names, Themes, Settings. Live progress for every card.
Supabase: database, private image storage, live updates, owner-only login (ADMINEMAIL).
Card worker (worker/, Python, runs on the PC): ComfyUI makes a text-free photo; Pillow stamps the exact
